summary.about: SCION 30 / SAM 2: per scene frame, what the dog did, measured from the rendered dog layer (x_screen, y_screen = alpha-weighted centroid in px; bbox; iou_prev = IoU of the dog silhouette with the previous frame at 320x180). state = the state the picture shows from its measured onset. facing: +1 toward the door (right), -1 away, 0 toward the camera.

measured_onsets.signal: the silhouette starts changing every frame or two (>= 3 changes of IoU<0.97 in 6 frames), where the idle hold changes once in 7
leaves the backing gait: head comes up (IoU below the gait minimum of the half second before)
the silhouette starts changing every frame or two (>= 3 changes of IoU<0.97 in 6 frames), where the idle hold changes once in 7
first rendered frame where a head part pointing at the door replaces the held head (silhouette change, body held)
the silhouette starts changing every frame or two (>= 3 changes of IoU<0.97 in 6 frames), where the idle hold changes once in 7
body top starts a sustained lowering (>= 6 px over 6 frames)
head proposal f47 (nose down) -> f01 mirrored (back of the head to the viewer, muzzle away into the room)
